You play a game where you and another player see the same four images but in different orders. 
Your task is to describe one image so that the other player can identify it. 
You both win if the other player picks the correct image based on your description. 

Describe the fourth image.

Begin your description with "Description: ". Say no more than what's absolutely needed to make the distinction. There is no need to explain your reasoning.

action.content: Description: This image features a large green sphere on the left side and a large blue sphere on the right side. The background consists of a greenish-blue horizontal wall, behind the spheres, behind and a dark purple wall at the back. The floor is brown-orange with yellowish-green vertical walls on the sides.

Description: This image features a large green sphere on the left side and a large blue sphere on the right side. The background consists of a greenish-blue horizontal wall, behind the spheres, behind and a dark purple wall at the back. The floor is brown-orange with yellowish-green vertical walls on the sides.
Which image fits the description?
